#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <utility>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

typedef pair<int, int> pr;
typedef long long ll;

const int maxn = 1000005;
const ll mod = 1000000007;

bool vis[maxn];

ll fastPow(ll a, int b) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
        b >>= 1;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fastPow(p, p - 1) << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << fastPow(p, p) << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
        if (vis[i]) continue;
        ll j = i;
        while (!vis[j]) {
            vis[j] = true;
            j = (j * k) % p;
        }
        cnt++;
    }
    cout << fastPow(p, cnt) << endl;
    return 0;
}
